case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your offer and for your clear wish to build a long-term partnership. We value that, and we want to make it work on a solid footing.

Our data shows a different picture:

Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

Given this, we would like to move forward with a firm proposal. It rests on dependable, steady work for your foundry and on reliable, punctual handling on our side:

Our proposal: quality commitment 2,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. You are right about the past prices and the delivery issues, we had some hiccups back then. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

We are happy to agree to the 2500 ppm to show we are serious about quality, but a 500 EUR chargeback is just too high. Our offer is a price of €48.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. I changed the chargeback to 150 EUR, and with that trade I can offer you a lower price of 46.00 EUR. As an alternative, we have a package with a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.

messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for checking our data and for your openness about the past delivery and price history. We appreciate it, and we welcome your agreement on the quality commitment.

On your cost drivers, here is what we see for labour:

German labour costs in manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).

We understand that faster payment matters to you. Our proposal below is built on reliable, punctual payment and steady call-offs:

Our proposal: quality commitment 2,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.96.

We believe this is a fair basis for a lasting partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

As to the index change data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
